desc.en: An aerial-type Slag made to imitate a dragon. Despite its enormous body, it can fly freely about in the air, annihilating any enemies below it. There are many cases of these patrolling an area, rather than guarding a specific location.
desc.ja: 竜を模した飛行タイプのスラグ。大きな体に似合わず、空中を自在に飛び回り、眼下の敵を蹂躙する。要所を守るより、哨戒するように飛び回っているケースが多い
